title: Intake Configuration
description: Schema for the GitHub organization intake scanner configuration. Supports schema versions 1.0 and 1.1.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this intake config. Use '1.1' for platform-aware features.

include_patterns.description: Glob patterns for repo names to include. Default: ['*'].

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns for repo names to exclude.

default_platform.description: Fallback platform when both auto-detection and platform_rules fail. Auto-detection handles the standard '*-for-Platform' repo naming convention plus GitHub language and topics.

name_pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against repo name (case-insensitive).

platform.description: Platform identifier for repos matching this pattern.

platform_rules.description: Optional overrides for auto-detection. Only needed when repo naming doesn't follow the standard '*-for-Platform' convention. Auto-detection handles Python, Java, .NET, C++, Go, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript. First match wins.

github_token_env.description: Environment variable name holding the GitHub API token. Optional for public repos — unauthenticated access allows 60 requests/hour.

per_page.description: Number of repos per page in GitHub API requests.

rate_limit_delay_s.description: Delay in seconds between paginated API requests.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch per organization.

activity_months.description: Only consider repos pushed within this many months.

require_readme.description: Require a README file for eligibility.

require_python.description: Require Python as a detected language. Superseded by require_language when set.

require_language.description: Require this language as the primary language. When set, takes precedence over require_python.

require_license.description: Require an OSS license for eligibility.

batch_size.description: Number of repos to process per scheduler run.

output_dir.description: Directory to write generated pilot configs.

template_path.description: Path to base pilot config template YAML.

state_dir.description: Directory for scan_state.json and schedule_state.json persistence files.
